q: The complex form of: The food was cold and I did not eat it.
o: The food was so cold that I did not ate it.
As the food was cold, I did not eat it.
Since the food was so cold, I could not eat it.
When the food been cold and I did not eat it.

q: Very few employees were as sincere as Mr. Kamal. (Make it superlative)
o: Mr. Kamal was one of the sincerest employee.
Mr. Kamal was one of the sincerest employees.
Mr. Kamal was the sincerest employee.
No other employee was the sincerest like Mr. Kamal.

q: As soon as I reached the station, the train left. (make it compound)
o: I reached the station and the train had left.
I reached the station and then the train left.
I reached the station and when the train left.
I reached the station and at that very moment the train left.

q: She looks very beautiful today, — ?
o: doesn't she
isn't it
is it
does she
e:
Tag question-এ মূল বাক্য affirmative হলে tag negative হয়। Tag-এর auxiliary verb আসে মূল বাক্যের verb ও subject অনুযায়ী। ‘She looks very beautiful today’ বাক্যটি Present Indefinite Tense-এ এবং subject তৃতীয় পুরুষ একবচন, তাই tag-এ ‘doesn’t she’ বসে। ‘Does she’ বসালে দুই অংশই affirmative হয়ে যায়, যা নিয়মবিরুদ্ধ। ‘Isn’t it’ ও ‘is it’-এ মূল verb ও subject মেলে না।
মনে রাখুন:
Negative বাক্যের tag affirmative হয়, যেমন She doesn’t come, does she?
Affirmative বাক্যের tag negative হয়, যেমন He plays well, doesn’t he?
s: বিদ্যুৎ, জ্বালানি ও খনিজ সম্পদ মন্ত্রণালয়, নিরাপত্তা কর্মকর্তা (২০১৯)

q: Very few places are as crowded as Farmgate. (Make it comparative)
o: Farmgate is the more crowded of all places.
Farmgate is one of the more crowded of all places.
Farmgate is more crowded than any other places.
Farmgate is more crowded than most other places.

q: Identify the Superlative Degree.
o: No other question is as difficult as this.
This is the most difficult question.
This question is more difficult than any other.
Very few questions are as difficult as this.

q: Identify the imperative sentence:
o: Shut up!
Shahin is playing football.
I shall cook dinner now.
What is your name?
e:
Imperative sentence বা অনুজ্ঞাসূচক বাক্য আদেশ, অনুরোধ বা উপদেশ বোঝায়। এই বাক্যে কর্তা 'you' সাধারণত উহ্য থাকে এবং ক্রিয়ার মূল রূপ দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হয়। 'Shut up!' একটি আদেশ, তাই এটি imperative। Shahin is playing football এবং I shall cook dinner now হলো assertive বা বিবৃতিমূলক, আর What is your name? হলো interrogative বা প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য।
উদাহরণ:
Open the door. Please help me.

q: Choose the correct sentence:
o: She likes ice cream, and so do I.
She likes ice cream, and so I does.
She likes ice cream, and so I did.
She likes ice cream, and so does I.
e: সম্মতি প্রকাশের বাক্যে প্রথম অংশ হ্যাঁ-সূচক হলে এবং তার সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে বলতে হলে so + auxiliary verb + subject গঠন ব্যবহার হয়, অর্থাৎ inversion ঘটে। প্রথম অংশে likes (present) এবং কর্তা I, তাই শেষে so do I বসে। শুদ্ধ বাক্য: She likes ice cream, and so do I। বিকল্প গঠন: She took pictures, and I did too। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: She took pictures, and so did I।

q: Had I the wings of a bird! (Make is Assertive)
o: I wish I had the wings of a bird.
I had the wings of a bird.
May I have the wings of a bird.
I should have the wings of a bird.

q: Something looks strange about the painting, ______?
o: hasn't it
isn't it
doesn’t it
is it

q: Which one is a simple sentence?
o: Do or die.
Choose only such friends as you can trust.
I made the man carry the load.

q: Bangladesh has six seasons, ____
o: haven't she?
hasn’t she?

q: ‘In spite of being old, he was young at heart.’ The compound sentence of it is ___
o: Though he was old he was young at heart
He was too old to be young at heart
He was old but young at heart
All of the above
e: Compound বাক্যে but দিয়ে বিরোধী অংশ জোড়া লাগে, তাই He was old but young at heart ঠিক। Though দিয়ে শুরু বাক্য অধীন clause বানায়, ফলে Complex। too ... to বাক্য Simple এবং অর্থও আলাদা। তাই 'All of the above' ভুল। বাংলায় অর্থ, বয়স্ক হলেও সে মনে ছিল তরুণ। In spite of + gerund = Though ... আর = ... but ...।

q: Change the sentence into compound: 'To his eternal disgrace, he betrayed his country'.
o: He disgrace eternally and he betrayed his country.
He betrayed his country and this was to his eternal disgrace.
He betrayed his country and it was his eternal disgrace.
It was eternal disgrace and he betrayed his country.
e: Compound sentence-এ দুটি স্বাধীন clause ‘and’ দিয়ে যুক্ত হয়। মূল বাক্যের phrase ‘to his eternal disgrace’ অক্ষুণ্ণ রেখে লিখলে হয়: He betrayed his country and this was to his eternal disgrace।

q: Complete the sentence: Only after food has been dried or canned ______________________.
o: should be stored for later consumption.
should it be stored for later consumption.
it should be stored for later consumption.
that it should be stored for later consumption.
e: Only after, only if, only when ও not until-এর মতো সীমাবদ্ধতাসূচক অংশ বাক্যের শুরুতে বসলে মূল clause-এ inversion হয়, অর্থাৎ auxiliary verb কর্তার আগে আসে। গঠন: Only after + clause + auxiliary + subject + main verb। তাই Only after food has been dried or canned should it be stored শুদ্ধ। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: Not until he got home did he realize that he had lost the book।

q: I wish you would tell me ___
o: who is being lived next door
who does live next door
who lives next door
who was living next door
e: wish-এর পর tell me ... দিয়ে একটি noun clause আসছে, যেখানে সাধারণ শব্দক্রম থাকে: who + ক্রিয়া। who এখানে কর্তা, তাই পরের ক্রিয়া সরাসরি lives। is being lived বা does live অপ্রয়োজনীয়, আর was living কালের দিক থেকে মেলে না। বাংলায় অর্থ, তুমি যদি আমাকে বলতে পাশের বাসায় কে থাকে।

q: A corrupt man cannot win the respect of others. [make it Complex]
o: A man who is corrupt cannot win the respect of others.
A man does not respect others who are corrupt.
A man who can win the respect of others cannot be corrupt.
A man who is corrupt cannot respect others.

q: Only the wise can give good advice. (Negative)
o: None but the wise gives advice.
None but the wise can give good advice.
None but good advice can be given by the wise.
None but advice is good.

q: Select the correct tag question : My sister doesn't like fish, —?
o: does she
did she
doesn't she
won't she
e:
Tag question-এ মূল বাক্য না-বাচক হলে tag হয় হ্যাঁ-বাচক, আর হ্যাঁ-বাচক হলে tag হয় না-বাচক। বাক্যটি doesn't like দিয়ে না-বাচক, তাই tag হবে হ্যাঁ-বাচক। Auxiliary হিসেবে does নিতে হবে এবং কর্তা My sister-এর জন্য pronoun she বসবে। ফলে সঠিক রূপ does she। Did she বসালে কাল মেলে না, আর doesn't she বা won't she বসালে না-বাচকের পরে আবার না-বাচক tag হয়ে যায়।
উদাহরণ:
She likes tea, doesn't she?
মনে রাখুন:
Let's-এর tag হয় shall we।
Imperative বাক্যের tag হয় will you।
I am-এর tag হয় aren't I।
s: কারিগরি শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, জুনিয়র ইন্সট্রাক্টর (পলিটেকনিক ও টেকনিক্যাল স্কুল) (২০২৩)

q: I know their residence (make it complex)
o: I know where they reside.
I know where did they reside.
I know where are they residing.
None of the above
e: noun phrase 'their residence'-কে noun clause 'where they reside' বানালে complex sentence হয়। noun clause-এ প্রশ্নবোধক গঠন (did they / are they) বসে না।
s: যুব উন্নয়ন অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী উপজেলা যুব উন্নয়ন কর্মকর্তা (২০২২)

q: He was ill, but he came for rehearsal. (Make it simple)
o: Despite of his illness, he came for rehearsal.
Although he was ill, he came for rehearsal.
Though he was ill, he came for rehearsal.
In spite of his illness, he came for rehearsal.

q: I wish I had seen you before. (Exclamatory)
o: Wow! I seen you before.
Had I seen you before!
Oh! I seen you before.
If I seen you before
e:
I wish I had... কাঠামো দিয়ে অতীতের এমন ইচ্ছার কথা বলা হয়, যা পূরণ হয়নি। এ ধরনের বাক্যকে exclamatory করতে If বাদ দিয়ে auxiliary verb had-কে কর্তার আগে আনা হয় এবং শেষে বিস্ময়চিহ্ন বসে। তাই ‘Had I seen you before!’ সঠিক রূপ, যার অর্থ ইস্, যদি তোমাকে আগে দেখতাম! অন্য বিকল্পগুলোর ‘I seen’ ব্যাকরণগতভাবেই ভুল।
মনে রাখুন: I wish I were a bird বাক্যের exclamatory রূপ হলো ‘Had I been a bird!’ বা ‘Would that I were a bird!’

q: The predicate of a sentence is ___
o: A verb
A person about whom something is said
What is said about subject
Which determines the subject
e: Predicate হলো বাক্যে subject সম্পর্কে যা বলা হয়, সেই অংশ। এতে শুধু ক্রিয়া নয়, ক্রিয়ার object, complement ও adverb-ও থাকতে পারে। তাই 'A verb' পুরো উত্তর নয়। 'A person about whom something is said' হলো subject-এর সংজ্ঞা। যেমন 'Birds fly high' বাক্যে Birds হলো subject আর 'fly high' হলো predicate।

q: Because of my illness, I could not attend the program. (complex)
o: Even though I was ill, I could not attend the program.
Though I was ill, I could not attend the program.
I was ill, I could not attend the program.
Since I was ill, I could not attend the program.

q: Choose the simple sentence of: I knew that they were horribly expensive.
o: I knew and they were horribly expensive.
I knew them but they were horribly expensive.
It was known that they were horribly expensive.
I knew them to be horribly expensive.
None of these
e:
I knew that they were horribly expensive বাক্যটিতে একটি principal clause (I knew) আর একটি noun clause (that they were horribly expensive) আছে, তাই এটি Complex sentence। Simple sentence বানাতে that-clause ভেঙে object ও to-infinitive বসাতে হয়: they হয় them, were হয় to be। তাই সঠিক রূপ: I knew them to be horribly expensive. (A) ও (B)-তে and/but দিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন clause জোড়া হয়েছে, ফলে এগুলো Compound sentence। (C)-তে that-clause থেকেই গেছে, তাই সেটি এখনো Complex।
মনে রাখুন: Simple sentence-এ একটিই finite verb থাকে। Know/believe/think/find + that-clause সাধারণত এভাবে বদলায়, যেমন I believe that he is honest থেকে I believe him to be honest।

q: ___ so many people been out of work as today.
o: More than ever before
Never before have
In the past, there never have
Formerly, there never were
e: Never before নেতিবাচক বাক্যাংশ শুরুতে এলে auxiliary আগে বসে: Never before have so many people been out of work। অর্থ: আজকের মতো এত বেশি মানুষ এর আগে কখনো কর্মহীন ছিল না। More than ever before বসালে সম্পূর্ণ আলাদা কাঠামো হয়। In the past এবং Formerly অংশের পরে there never have বা never were নেতিবাচক আদেশে Inversion ছাড়াই বসে, তাই মেলে না।

q: Identify the imperative sentence.
o: I shall go to college
Matin is singing a song
Stand up
It has been raining since morning
e:
যে বাক্যে আদেশ, অনুরোধ বা উপদেশ থাকে, তাকে Imperative Sentence বলে। এ ধরনের বাক্যে Subject ‘you’ সাধারণত উহ্য থাকে। ‘Stand up’ এমন একটি বাক্য, যেখানে কাউকে উঠে দাঁড়াতে বলা হচ্ছে। বাকি তিনটি বাক্য সাধারণ বিবৃতি, যা কোনো কাজ বা ঘটনার তথ্য দেয়।
উদাহরণ:
Open the door. (আদেশ)
Please help me. (অনুরোধ)
মনে রাখুন: নিষেধ বোঝাতে Don't দিয়ে শুরু হয়, যেমন ‘Don't run.’

o: No sooner the boy had met with a road accident, Kabir decided to help him.
No sooner had the boy met with a road accident, Kabir decided to help him.
As soon as the boy did not met with a road accident, Kabir decided to help him.
No sooner had the boy met with a road accident than Kabir decided to help him.

don't he?

o: When you are not attentive, you cannot pass the exam.
If you don’t be attentive, you cannot pass the exam.

Be attentive so that you cannot pass the exam.

q: In spite of his having riches, he leads a poor life. The complex form of the sentence is –
o: Although he was riches, he leads a poor life.
Although he has been riches, he leads a poor life.
Although he had riches, he lead a poor life.
Although he has riches, he leads a poor life.

q: Identify the compound sentence.
o: When the bell rang, the students entered the room.
Ringing the bell, the teacher entered the room.
The bell rang, and the students entered the room.
Both ক & গ

q: What is the best interrogative form of the sentence? 'Everybody wants to be rich.'
o: Does not everybody want to be rich?
Who does not want to be rich?
Why not everybody wants to be rich?
None of the above sentences
e: Everybody/everyone থাকলে interrogative-এ 'Who + does not + main verb' ব্যবহার করা হয়, কারণ ভাবটি rhetorical: সবাই চায়। তাই 'Who does not want to be rich?' সঠিক। অর্থ: কে না ধনী হতে চায়? 'Does not everybody want' শুনতে ঠিক, কিন্তু এটি এই ছাঁচের প্রচলিত উত্তর নয়। 'Why not everybody wants' গঠনটি ভুল, কারণ WH-word-এর পরে সহায়ক ক্রিয়া ঠিকভাবে আসেনি।

q: Identify the incorrect sentence.
o: Dhaka has no snow in winter, has it?
I have not done my homework, have l?
Dirty water is not safe, is it?
We have not finished the work, had I?

q: Make it comparative: Serena Williams is one of the most accomplished female athletes in the world.
o: Serena Williams is more accomplished than many other female athlete in the world.
Serena Williams is more accomplished than all other female athletes in the world.
Serena Williams is more accomplished than most other female athletes in the world.
Serena Williams is more accomplished than any other female athlete in the world.

q: Choose the right interrogative of the following sentence: 'Your father came home last night.'
o: Had your father came home last night?
Did your father come home last night?
Have your father came home last night?
Was your father came home last night?
e: Past Indefinite বাক্যকে interrogative করতে Did বসে এবং main verb আবার base form-এ ফিরে যায়। তাই came বদলে come: 'Did your father come home last night?'। অর্থ: গতরাতে কি তোমার বাবা বাড়ি এসেছিলেন? Had, Have ও Was দিয়ে প্রশ্ন বানালে tense বদলে যায়। আর এসব অপশনে main verb came (V2) থেকেই গেছে, যা helping verb-এর পরে বসে না। সূত্র: Did + subject + V1 for Past Indefinite প্রশ্ন।

shall we
are you

q: Choose the correct Assertive form: Who does not admire honesty?
o: Everyone admires honesty.
Nobody admires honesty.

q: Jerry was only four years old. (Negative)
o: Jerry was not four years old
Jerry was not more than four years old
No one but Jerry was four years old
None but Jerry was four years old
e:
Only যুক্ত বাক্যকে negative করতে হলে only বাদ দিয়ে তার জায়গায় not more than বা none but বসাতে হয়। Only যদি কোনো সংখ্যা বা পরিমাণের আগে বসে, তখন not more than ব্যবহার করা হয়। এখানে only বসেছে ‘four years’-এর আগে, তাই negative রূপ ‘Jerry was not more than four years old.’
মনে রাখুন: Only যদি কোনো ব্যক্তির আগে বসে, তখন none but বসে, যেমন Only Allah can help us → None but Allah can help us।

q: Although he was afraid, he did not utter any sound. (make it simple)
o: Despite being afraid, he did not utter any sound.
In spite being afraid, he did not utter any sound.
He was afraid in spite of not uttering any sound.
Because of being afraid, he did not utter any sound.

q: 'Never tell a lie.'
o: Interrogative
Assertive
Optative
Imperative
e: 'Never tell a lie' ক্রিয়া 'tell' দিয়ে শুরু, আর subject 'you' উহ্য। এটি মিথ্যা বলতে নিষেধ করছে, তাই এটি imperative sentence। অর্থ: কখনও মিথ্যা বোলো না। Imperative বাক্যে নিষেধ বোঝাতে Do not বা Never ক্রিয়ার আগে বসে। এতে প্রশ্ন নেই, কামনা নেই, তথ্য জানানোও নেই, তাই বাকি তিন ধরন ঠিক নয়।

q: Helen was the most beautiful woman in the world. (Positive)
o: Very few women in the world were as beautiful as Helen.
No other womans in the world were as beautiful as Helen.
Helen was more beautiful than any other woman in the world.
No other woman in the world was as beautiful as Helen.

q: Unless you move, you will die. Make it an affirmative sentence.
o: Move not to die
Move to escape death.
Move or die
To escape death, you should move.
e: 'Unless you move, you will die' মানে 'নড়াচড়া না করলে তুমি মরবে'। Unless মানে if not, তাই এটি negative। এটিকে affirmative করলে ভাব দাঁড়ায় 'মরা এড়াতে তোমার নড়া উচিত': To escape death, you should move. 'Move not to die' ভাষাগতভাবে ভুল গঠন। 'Move or die' আদেশ রূপে চলে যায় এবং শর্তের ভাব হারায়। দুটি clause-এর সম্পর্ক বজায় রেখে affirmative রূপ দিতে হলে purpose বা condition বোঝানো infinitive (To escape...) ব্যবহার হয়।

q: Very few cities are as big as Dhaka. Make it comparative.
o: Dhaka is more bigger than any other cities.
Dhaka is bigger than any other cities.
Dhaka is bigger than most other cities.
No other cities is bigger than Dhaka.

q: “I won’t be late.” The correct response may be ___.
o: “So do I”
“Me neither”
“I too”
“Nor am I!”
e: মূল বাক্য নেতিবাচক, তাই সম্মতি হবে নেতিবাচক। Me neither কথ্য ভাষায় সঠিক ও প্রচলিত উত্তর। অর্থ: আমি দেরি করব না, আমিও না। So do I ইতিবাচক সম্মতি। I too ইতিবাচক বাক্যে বসে। Nor am I-তে auxiliary ভুল, কারণ মূল বাক্যে will আছে, তাই Nor will I হওয়া উচিত।

q: He died in the village where he was born. The simple form of the complex sentence is -
o: He died in his village.
He was born in a village and died in the same village.
He died in his native village
He died in a village where his birth took place.

q: A rolling stone gathers no moss. (make it compound)
o: A stone is rolling therefore it gathers no moss.
Though a stone rolls, it gathers no moss.
A stone that rolls gathers no moss.
A stone what rolls gathers no moss.

q: The boy is so little that he cannot do this small task. (Make it simple)
o: The boy is too little to do this small task.
The boy is so little and he cannot do this small task.
The boy is so little that he cannot do this small task.
The boy is too little so that he cannot do this small task.

q: Tuni is as clever as Runi. ( Make it comparative)
o: Tuni is not less cleverer than Runi.
Tuni is not cleverer as Runi.
Tuni is not less clever than Runi.
Tuni is not cleverer than Runi.

q: When she was ten, she started learning French. (Make it simple)

In the age of ten, she started learning French.
On the age of ten, she started learning French.

q: What is the compound form of: "Without practicing daily, you cannot master the language"?
o: Practice daily and you cannot master the language.
You practice daily, so you master the language
Unless you practice daily, you master the language.

q: ‘All that glitters is not gold’. This is a –
o: Compound sentence
Simple sentence
Imperative sentence
Complex sentence

q: Which one is a compound sentence?
o: Seeing the police the thief ran away
The thief saw the police while he ran away
When the thief saw the police, he ran away
The thief saw the police and ran away
e: The thief saw the police and ran away-এ and দিয়ে দুটি ক্রিয়া (saw, ran) সমান মর্যাদায় যুক্ত, তাই এটি Compound sentence। Seeing the police the thief ran away-তে participle phrase আছে, তাই Simple। When the thief saw the police, he ran away-তে When-clause অধীন, তাই Complex। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে while সংযোজক অধীন clause বানায়, তাই সেটিও Complex। বাংলায় অর্থ, চোর পুলিশ দেখে পালিয়ে গেল।

q: Find correct interrogative : None can do this.
o: Can none do this?
Do this can be don?
Who can do this?
Can this be done none?
e:
কোনো বাক্যকে assertive থেকে interrogative-এ বদলানোর সময় তার অর্থ একই রাখতে হয়। None, Nobody বা No one দিয়ে গড়া বাক্যে নেতিবাচক ভাব থাকে। প্রশ্নবোধক রূপে এই শব্দগুলোর জায়গায় Who বসে এবং ক্রিয়াটি হ্যাঁ-বাচক রূপে থাকে। তাই ‘None can do this’ বদলে হয় ‘Who can do this?’। এর ভাবার্থ দাঁড়ায়, এই কাজ কেউ করতে পারে না। প্রথম ও চতুর্থ বিকল্পে none শব্দটি রয়ে গেছে, ফলে নেতিবাচক শব্দ প্রশ্নের ভেতরেই থেকে গেছে। দ্বিতীয় বিকল্পের শব্দক্রম আর ক্রিয়ার রূপ, দুটোই ভুল।
মনে রাখুন:
None, Nobody, No one → Who।
Nothing → What।
উদাহরণ:
Nobody likes pain. → Who likes pain?
No one can stop him. → Who can stop him?
Nothing is impossible. → What is impossible?

q: The dress is very beautiful. (Exclamatory)
o: What beautiful the dress is!
How beautiful the dress!
How beautiful the dress is!
How a beautiful the dress is!

q: Choose the best interrogative form of 'Everyone hates acid-throwing.'
o: Do anyone like acid-throwing?
Is there anyone who can hate acid-throwing?
Who does accept acid-throwing?
Does anyone like acid-throwing?
e: Assertive বাক্যে everyone থাকলে interrogative-এ 'Does anyone + ...' বা 'Who + does not + ...' ব্যবহার হয়। এখানে hate-এর বিপরীত like, তাই 'Does anyone like acid-throwing?' সঠিক। অর্থ: অ্যাসিড নিক্ষেপ কেউ পছন্দ করে কি? ভাবটি rhetorical, অর্থাৎ কেউ পছন্দ করে না। 'Do anyone' ভুল, কারণ anyone একবচন, তাই Does বসে। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে hate রেখে অর্থ বদলে গেছে। তৃতীয়টি গঠনগতভাবে অস্বাভাবিক।

q: No other flower is as beautiful as the daisy in the garden. (Superlative)
o: The daisy is the most beautiful flowers in the garden.
The daisy is the most beautiful flower in garden.
The daisy is the most beautiful flower in the garden.
The daisy is one of the most beautiful flower in the garden.

q: The Northern part is cooler than the Southern part in Winter. (Positive degree)
o: The Southern part is not so cool as the Northern part in Winter.

The Southern part is as cool the Northern part in Winter.
